# Manzil Homes

> Manzil Homes (also known as Manzil Constructions & Interiors) is a women-led luxury interior design and construction company based in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), serving Visakhapatnam, Hyderabad and all of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, India. It designs and builds Vastu-aligned homes, villas and apartments, and premium commercial spaces, with transparent pricing and on-time delivery.

## Key facts
- Business type: Interior design and construction (design-and-build) company
- Office: 10/326/1, Vishalakshi Nagar, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 530040, India
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=15432707297470901251
- Opening hours: open all days (Monday to Sunday), 9:00 am to 7:00 pm
- Service area: Andhra Pradesh: Visakhapatnam / Vizag (MVP Colony, Madhurawada, Rushikonda, Seethammadhara, Vishalakshi Nagar), Vijayawada, Guntur, Amaravati, Tirupati, Nellore, Kakinada, Rajahmundry. Telangana: Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Gachibowli, Kondapur, Hitech City, Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills, Kokapet, Narsingi, Kukatpally, Warangal, Karimnagar
- Founder & CEO: Shaik Miza Mehroz, Civil Engineer and Interior Designer (B.E. Civil Engineering and M.Tech Structural Engineering, Andhra University), 5+ years in design and interiors. Philosophy: "Every structure deserves a strong foundation, every space deserves thoughtful design, and every client deserves excellence."
- Women-led company
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94920 54954
- Email: manzil.homes24@gmail.com
- Website: https://manzils.in
- Consultations: free (call, WhatsApp, email or the website contact form)

## Services
- Luxury residential interiors for apartments, villas and penthouses
- Architecture and house / villa construction
- Renovation and remodeling
- Modular kitchens and wardrobes
- Theme-based and artistic interiors
- Commercial interior design: offices, workplaces, cafés and showrooms
- 3D interior visualization
- Structural engineering, pre-engineered building (PEB) projects and structural analysis / stability studies
- Custom furniture and interior execution
- Vastu-aligned planning

## How Manzil Homes works
1. Discovery: lifestyle mapping, Vastu inputs and budget clarity
2. Concept & 3D: mood, materials and 3D renders
3. Detailing: technical drawings, joinery and lighting layers
4. Build & handover: on-site execution, quality checks, on-time handover and after-care

## What sets it apart
- Vastu-aligned design from day one
- Transparent pricing and BOQs, no hidden costs
- Milestone-based schedules and on-time delivery
- End-to-end: one team from concept and 3D design to construction and handover
- Free consultation
